checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: Check reservoir_columns_within_15ml failed: etoh[i % 4] draws 16000 µL from columns 9 and 10 (nest 12-well ~15 mL), which exceeds the well capacity.

Check fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact passed (48 distinct tips); p1000 uses a fresh tip per sample, reagent tips never touch sample wells (dispense at col.top(-2)), removal and elution use a fresh tip per column, and every tip is dropped.
The ethanol allocation overdraws reservoir columns 9 and 10 (16000 µL each), so the run as coded cannot be carried out with the specified reservoir quantities.
The step-4 loop maps 48 tubes to plate.columns()[2*(s//8)][s%8], i.e. odd columns, one sample per well; check 48_samples_to_odd_columns passed and distinct_elution_wells passed.

Beads 40, isopropanol 250, then 250 µL sample with p1000.mix(5,...), a 5 min delay, mag.engage() with a 4 min delay, then 540 µL removed to waste; checks binding_volumes, mix_5x, incubation and magnet_4min passed.
Two 500 µL ethanol additions, each followed by removal with the magnet engaged, then a 4 min delay and mag.disengage() before elution; checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min passed.

100 µL elution is added after mag.disengage() and mixed, then a 30 s delay, engage, and a 90 s delay; 80 µL is transferred to a distinct well of the elution plate on the tempdeck set to 4 °C; elution checks passed.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the specified steps closely and passes 16 of 17 run-log checks, with correct tip handling, magnet states and timings. It fails robot_practice because ethanol is drawn at 16000 µL from reservoir columns 9 and 10, above the roughly 15 mL well capacity.
